name: captions
description: Restyle a project's captions in one call: look (highlight = white text with the spoken word in colour, or a caption style), color (the text colour), highlight (the spoken word's colour), accent ({"words": [...], "color": "cyan"}: those words or phrases in their own colour wherever said; "none" removes it), position (top, middle, bottom: written on each caption, so a caption added later sits at the bottom) and size (px, small, medium, large, N%, Nx, bigger, smaller). A colour or size set for all clears each caption's own, and the answer counts them. Writes the captions only, a version first; a caption edit since it read them is refused. Needs captions: generate_captions makes them.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {style, segments, color?, highlight? (the spoken-word colour in force), position?, size?, cleared? ({field: captions whose own value it replaced}), accent?: {found: {word: sayings}, missed: {word: [near misses]}}, issues?}. detail adds the track's styling fields.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: look
params.description: highlight: white text, the spoken word in colour. Or a caption style.

params.name: color
params.description: The text colour: a hex, a CSS colour name or rgb()/hsl().

params.name: accent
params.description: {"words": ["pauses", "best"], "color": "cyan"}: those words (or phrases) in their own colour wherever said. color none removes it.

params.name: size
params.description: Text size: px, small, medium, large, N% or Nx, or bigger / smaller than now.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the track's styling fields.
